screened_out: Secondary news, Reddit and automatically generated paper summaries were used only as discovery leads, not as evidence.
Product-scale OpenAI/Anthropic aggregate usage studies do not supply the raw linked histories needed here; their taxonomies are adjacent rather than a substitute for public validation.
Life-planning interview studies require recruited samples and are less direct than the released self-report and grounding datasets for this no-recruitment task.
coverage_limits: Searches prioritize the direct WildChat comparator and citation-connected primary studies; no completeness or first-ever claim is made.
Only one WildChat shard and its first 2,000 content rows were acquired; larger eligibility counts are not inferred.
ThoughtTrace, PRISM and Re-Centering Humans were audited for metadata and release design, not fully recounted or empirically validated.
